questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The requested site is static and frontend-only; vanilla JavaScript supports the theme toggle and gentle interactions without unnecessary infrastructure.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Adds static typing for larger or more complex frontends.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: A direct fit for a lightweight static site with no build-time framework requirement.

questions.question: Which frontend framework or approach should be used?
questions.rationale: The brief has enough visual detail to define a static design; vanilla web technologies are a good fit for the requested scope.

options.label: Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
options.description: Keeps the site static, lightweight, and dependency-free.

options.label: React
options.description: Offers component-based structure for more complex interactive experiences.

questions.question: What frontend features should be included?
questions.answer: Responsive monochrome/futuristic landing page, subtle animated background, interactive motion, light/dark theme toggle, and pill-shaped bottom navigation.
questions.rationale: These features directly capture the supplied visual references and requested redesign.
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive monochrome/futuristic landing page, subtle animated background, interactive motion, light/dark theme toggle, and pill-shaped bottom navigation.

questions.question: Does the application need a datastore?
questions.rationale: No persistence or user-uploaded content is required for the requested static frontend.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The static site has no persistence, uploads, queues, or backend data.

options.label: Azure Blob Storage
options.description: Stores files, images, or other static media.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Relational data storage for application records.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to use application API features?
questions.rationale: The project is a static frontend-only site without application APIs or sign-in requirements.

options.label: Yes
